summary: Dossiers were mostly sound on team facts, matching CURRENT FACTS (record, West finals loss, trades, Mara, Cup group, key dates). Three live checks found real location errors: the outlet center is now OKC Outlets on I-40 (Nike Factory Store confirmed), Ma Der Lao Kitchen is in the Plaza District not the Asian District, and Shop Good is in Midtown. Other fixes: Hornets 2005-07 history, Durant titles, Collison dates, Memphis division, the banner night, WCWS venue name, Jones Assembly neighborhood, an invented SoSo slang term, and the Specter question (OKC is excluded). Brief problems for the editor: Chanchaleune as Asian District anchor, Shop Good placement, 2026-27 vs 2027-28 City Edition framing, past-dated 2026 windows, and the unconfirmed Oct 22 home status. Remaining small businesses and 2027 event dates are queued as unverifiable.
